classification_agent.name: Application & Project Classification Agent
classification_agent.description: Analyzes input to classify application type, product, module, domain, and project state

domain_analysis_agent.name: Domain & Requirements Analysis Agent
domain_analysis_agent.description: Extracts business rules, roles, data rules, and implicit validations from requirements

positive_test_agent.name: Positive Test Case Generation Agent
positive_test_agent.description: Generates happy path and valid scenario test cases

negative_edge_case_agent.name: Negative & Edge Case Generation Agent
negative_edge_case_agent.description: Generates negative scenarios, boundary conditions, and edge cases using EP, BVA, pairwise techniques

security_nf_agent.name: Security & Non-Functional Test Agent
security_nf_agent.description: Generates security, performance, and non-functional test cases

traceability_agent.name: Requirements Traceability Agent
traceability_agent.description: Maps test cases to requirements/ACs and ensures complete coverage

deduplication_agent.name: Test Deduplication & Optimization Agent
deduplication_agent.description: Identifies and removes duplicate/redundant test cases, optimizes test suite

excel_export_agent.name: Excel Export Agent
excel_export_agent.description: Exports final test cases and traceability matrix to Excel format
